name: Maple Parfait
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: large cupful of maple syrup
ingredients.originalText: a large cupful of maple syrup

instructions.text: Beat the yolks of ten eggs very light, and add a large cupful of maple syrup.
Put it over the fire, stir till it thickens, then take off and beat till cold.
Add quickly a quart of cream beaten till it is perfectly stiff.
Pour into a two-quart melon mould.
Pack in ice and salt for five or six hours.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the yolks of ten eggs very light, and add a large cupful of maple syrup.
2. Put it over the fire, stir till it thickens, then take off and beat till cold.
3. Add quickly a quart of cream beaten till it is perfectly stiff.
4. Pour into a two-quart melon mould.
5. Pack in ice and salt for five or six hours.
